¢ Avoid rough handling in transportation; the picture tube is fragile.
e This machine is designed for “indoor” use. So install the machine indoors only.
e Install the machine on flat-surfaced floor (made of concrete, etc.) and provide suitable space around it. Do not install the machine in locations with vibrations.
° Do not install the machine in locations exposed to sunlight or excessive heat to avoid the environmental temperature rise. Also, do not install the machine at places where it is humid and/or dusty.
e Do not install the machine in dangerous places in view of disaster prevention, five alarm equipment, etc.
e Never fail to connect the "ground terminal” of the machine and the "ground line” of the porer supply cord.

¢ Before turning on the power switch! The screws for fastening the parts may be loosened by vibrations, etc. in transpotation. Make certain that the PC board is correctly attached and the connectors are perfectly plugged.
e Plug the power cord plug into the outlet and turn on the power switch. Before this, make sure the power supply and the current capacity.

e In case that any malfunction occures after turning on the power: First, turn off the power switch, and check the power supply and each output by referring the handling care. This machine does not work normally unless the proper power supply voltage is supplied.
e This game uses microprocessors and other ICs for long stable performance life, however, as with sophisticated electronic equipment, certain precaution must be observed to avoid damage.
